capabilities.text: Allow a nurse to enter a ward note once and automatically send the exact same note to both Meditech and CareFlow immediately after saving, with no extra steps.
Alert the nurse immediately within 10 seconds if sending the note to either Meditech or CareFlow fails, showing the specific system and reason for failure.
Enable nurses to open a blank note form for any patient assigned to their shift from a simple dashboard listing their patients.
Provide ward managers with a read-only dashboard showing all patients on their ward grouped by nurse, with the most recent note summary and ability to view full notes.
Allow ward managers to flag a note by submitting a 'Report Issue' with predefined reasons, sending a notification to the nurse's inbox without editing the original note.
Provide IT staff with a real-time dashboard showing all send attempts in the last 24 hours, including successes, failures, and pending sends, with detailed error messages for failures.
Retry sending notes automatically only for temporary failures (e.g., brief system outages) a few times over a short period, then stop retries and alert nurse and IT for permanent failures.
Keep unsent notes visible and marked as not sent in the nurse's view after a failed send and manual retry, so no data is lost and the nurse can act accordingly.
Save unsent draft notes per nurse during shift changes and reload them on the nurse's next login without sending anything until explicitly saved.

Display a success confirmation to the nurse after saving a note, including a green checkmark, the message 'Note saved and sent to both systems,' a soft chime, and instantly clear the form for the next note.
Show patient name and ID, nurse name and shift time at the top of the note form, followed by a plain text box for clinical text entry, a save button, and a progress indicator during sending.
Enforce mandatory clinical text entry before allowing a nurse to save a note, blocking empty saves with a clear message.
Restrict access so nurses see only their own notes, ward managers see only notes from their own ward, and IT sees only system logs without note content unless a send failed.
When a ward manager flags a note, mark the original note as 'Flagged' in the nurse's view without altering the note content, until the nurse responds.
Provide a failure view for nurses after a second failed manual retry, showing a red banner with the failure reason and a 'Contact IT' button that sends a report automatically.
Ensure the system does not store permanent copies of notes; only send notes to Meditech and CareFlow, log send attempts and statuses, and keep no long-term note data.
Support user roles with distinct dashboards and capabilities: nurses for note entry, ward managers for note viewing and flagging, and IT for monitoring send logs and troubleshooting.
Operate on a UK-region cloud provider approved by hospital IT, compliant with UK GDPR and NHS Data Security and Protection Toolkit standards.
